_meta.category: Global Migration, Diaspora, Expat Life & Visa Systems
_meta.description: Comprehensive data on international migration flows, refugee populations, visa systems, expat life metrics, diaspora communities, remittances, brain drain, digital nomad visas, golden visas, citizenship by investment, and second-generation immigrant outcomes. All data points sourced from UN DESA, UNHCR, World Bank, IOM, OECD, InterNations, and government statistical agencies.
